name: CharadesSTA
description: Charades-STA is a benchmark dataset for temporal activity localization via language queries, extending the Charades dataset with sentence temporal annotations. It contains 12,408 training and 3,720 testing segment-sentence pairs from videos with natural language descriptions and precise temporal boundaries for localizing activities based on language queries.
evaluation_method: R@1 IoU@0.5 and R@1 IoU@0.7 (recall at 1 with IoU threshold)
reputation: Standard benchmark for video temporal grounding; published at ICCV 2017; widely used for natural language-guided moment localization in videos
notes: Published at ICCV 2017. Extends the Charades dataset with start/end time annotations paired with natural language sentences. 16,128 total segment-sentence pairs. Standard for temporal sentence grounding (moment retrieval) tasks. Human activities are recorded in home environments, making the domain relatively constrained.
